Overview

Hattiesburg is a city in MS with a population of 46,000. Hub City with the University of Southern Mississippi and a growing healthcare sector. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8b growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.7.
